title: tods-validate JSON report
description: Output of `tods-validate validate --format json`. Stable: fields are only added, never removed or renamed, within a major version.

toolVersion.description: Version of tods-validate that produced the report.

reportVersion.description: Version of this report schema. Fields are only added within a major version.

specVersion.description: TODS specification version the rules implement.

source.description: The path that was validated, as given on the command line.

byRule.description: Count of findings per rule ID, most frequent first.

row.description: 1-based line number; the header row is line 1.

data.description: Structured machine context (offending value, referenced ID, etc.). Additive; null for rules not yet migrated to emit it.

caused_by.description: Location identifier (see 'location') of the root finding that structurally caused this one, e.g. a TODS-E104 ragged row that left this field blank. Null when this finding is not a known downstream echo of another.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex content fingerprint used as the --baseline identity (rule_id, file, field, data); excludes row and message so inserted rows don't churn a baseline.

severity_original.description: The rule's spec-declared severity, set only when a config `[severity]` table remapped `severity` to a different value. Every remapped finding is also disclosed in text/Markdown/SARIF/HTML output.

coverage.description: Validation-assurance manifest: which rules ran versus were skipped and why. Added in report schema 1.2.0.

skippedByReason.description: Rule IDs skipped, keyed by status (e.g. 'skipped:needs_gtfs').

status.description: 'ran' means the check executed against data it could read. Every other value is a skip: the check did not run, and its rule must not be read as passed. 'skipped:needs_gtfs_table' means a companion feed was available but did not contain a GTFS file the check reads.

measurement.description: How much of its input a rule that ran was able to examine. Present only on a rule that ran and reported one. Units counted as unmeasurable were not examined: they are never added to 'measured' and must never be read as having passed, and a non-zero count always carries its reason.

localPolicy.description: The agency's own LOCAL- rules, one per setting in the [policy] table of tods-validate.toml (ADR 0009). Present only when a policy was loaded. Its counts are separate from the totals above, which describe the rule set this project ships, and its rules are the agency's, not the TODS specification's.

status.description: As for the rule set above: 'ran' means the check executed against data it could read, and every other value is a skip that must not be read as passed.

measurement.description: As for the rule set above. A local rule that ran always carries one, including when it measured nothing, and then 'reason' says why.

policySetting.description: The [policy] setting that configured this rule, as it reads in the table, e.g. 'max-spread-minutes = 660'.

suggestions.description: Machine-form companion to the text/Markdown --suggest block: one entry per mechanically-derived fix. Present only when --suggest is used with JSON output. Added in report schema 1.3.0.

kind.description: 'auto' is meaning-preserving (tods-validate fix applies it); 'review' wants a human's confirmation.

row.description: 1-based line number; the header row is line 1.

current.description: The value found in the feed, when the fix changes one value.

proposed.description: The value the fix would write, when the fix changes one value.
